metcon.name: Workout
metcon.description:
Buy IN
20 Thrusters @ 60/40
Then 6 rounds;
16 Push Ups
8 Toes to bar
4 Bear Complexes @ 60/40
16 KB Snatches @ 24/16
12 Pull Ups
16 Box Jumps 24/20"
8 Power Cleans @ 60/40
100m Run together
BUY OUT
2000m Row
Scale weight to 40/30
Scale T2B to V-Ups or Tuck Sits
Scale Push Ups to Knee Push Ups
Scale Pull Ups to Banded or Ring Rows
Partition as Required

hypertrophy.reasoning: Today hammers quads, shoulders, and triceps heavily via thrusters, push-ups, and gymnastics. Accessory work targets posterior chain balance and arm antagonists.
